title: Otter in Surreal Lounge
description: Two realistic otters occupy a stylized living room, one lounging on a teal couch in the foreground while another peers from behind it. The room features leafy tropical wallpaper, a sun-shaped clock, a wooden coffee table with a feather, and opens into a swirling fiery purple and orange vortex portal on the right.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene of two realistic river otters in a cozy living room, one lounging on a teal corduroy couch looking at viewer, another peeking from behind the couch, tropical fern wallpaper, sun-shaped clock on the wall, purple lamp, wooden coffee table with a single blue feather, on the right side the room dissolves into a swirling fiery orange and purple vortex portal, whimsical and dreamlike atmosphere, painted in rich vibrant colors
